blocks.text: This (Being) excellent of art, did He who is God above all, as a good Father beget as good Fruit, the ONLY (begotten) SON, and give (him) to this world (as) a most excellent gift; did cast as a Soul into a body destitute of soul, and into the nature of irrational bodies, His own rational WORD: and (so), by virtue of the DIVINE WORD, did He both enlighten and enliven this (otherwise) shapeless, unsightly and colourless, being [Lee’s Syriac and Greek gloss omitted] —by Him, (I say) whom we ought, both to know and to worship, as being ever near to the matter and elements, of (all) bodies.
